(api-gui-forms-atomicthreadpool)=
## AtomicThreadPool

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/threading.hpp>
class AtomicThreadPool final
```

The owner's threadpool_atomic_fast algorithm: synchronous batches, reusable task storage, native pthread workers. Small batches may run on the caller. Methods belong to one owner thread; entries borrow contexts until run returns.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit AtomicThreadPool(std::uint32_t threads)` |  |
| `~AtomicThreadPool()` |  |
| `std::uint32_t thread_count() const noexcept` |  |
| `void run(std::span<const AtomicTask> tasks)` |  |

## CancellationFlag

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/threading.hpp>
class CancellationFlag final
```

Cooperative cancellation. A request is permanent; observing it acquires writes preceding request(). It does not interrupt I/O or wake a condition.

(api-gui-forms-worker)=
## Worker

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/threading.hpp>
class Worker final
```

One asynchronous task on threadpool_atomic_fast. The named entry borrows context until join or destruction finishes. Declare the worker AFTER its context owner. Only request_cancel is concurrent-safe; join/destruction belong to the creating thread, never to the worker itself.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit Worker(Entry entry, void* context)` |  |
| `~Worker()` |  |
| `void request_cancel() noexcept` |  |
| `void join()` | Waits without requesting cancellation. Rethrows an entry failure once, after joining. Repeated joins are harmless. Self-join throws logic_error. |

**Data members and type aliases**

```cpp
using Entry = void (*)(const CancellationFlag& cancellation, void* context);
```
